jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Testing Department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for an

Intern at the Testing Department of the E-Aircraft Systems House (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship and want to learn about implementing a scalable, cloud-based platform serving as the "single source of truth" for all test data and enable automated insights? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Testing Department of the E-Aircraft Systems House as an intern (d/f/m)!

As an intern you will learn how to unify and transform fragmented E-Aircraft test data into actionable engineering knowledge. You will gain experience in designing and implementing a digital thread, moving high-volume test yields from on-premise storage to a scalable cloud data lake (Skywise Cloud). You will learn the entire analytics lifecycle.

- Location: Taufkirchen
- Start: April 2026
- Duration: 6 months

Your location
Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Program data post-processing routines using cloud-native tools to harmonize raw test data.
- Design and create automated data analytics pipelines within the cloud solution, managing flow from ingestion to prepared datasets.
- Execute advanced data analysis and exploration (interactive or code-based)
- Create final visualizations and dashboards to share key metrics

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled student (d/f/m) computer science, data science, IT, engineering or similar field of study
- Knowledge in Python, Pandas/Polars (Programming in general)
- Experience using Microsoft Office or Google Suite
- Fluent in English, German skills are a plus
- You are a good team player, have excellent communication skills, and are able to work independently.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth
